negative_snippets:
Worst experience ever with OYO! 👎 I booked a room, paid in advance, and cancelled within a few hours — still they refused to refund even a single rupee. Their so-called “policy” is just an excuse to loot customers. Staff doesn’t care, customer support repeats the same line like a robot.

It’s funny how big companies talk about “customer satisfaction” but can’t even handle a small genuine refund. Such unprofessional behavior — shame on OYO for fooling loyal customers. I’ll never book from OYO again, and I’d suggest others to stay away unless you want to waste your time and money.
